spans.s:
r. 5th. cl. (स्पृणोति)
1 To please, to gratify.
2 To cherish, to protect.
3 To breathe, to live.

f. (-क्का)
A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
स्पृश to touch, कक् aff., form. irr.; also पृक्का.

r. 6th cl. (स्पृशति)
To touch, to take with the hand.
With उप,
1 To tread upon.
2 To bathe, to sip water, &c.

f. (-शा)
A plant, commonly Kaṅkālī.
E.
स्पृश to touch, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
Who or what touches.
E.
स्पृश to touch, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-शन्-शती-शन्ती-शत्)
Touching.
E.
स्पृश to touch, शतृ aff.

f. (-शी)
A prickly nightshade, (Solanum Jacquini.)
E.
स्पृश to touch, क and ङीष् affs.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
What may be or is to be felt or touched.
E.
स्पृश to touch, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Touched, felt.
E.
स्पृश to touch, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
What is to be or may be touched, felt, &c., स्पृश to touch, तव्य aff.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Touch, feeling, contact.
E.
स्पृश to touch, क्तिन् aff.

ind.
Having felt or touched.
E.
स्पृश to touch, क्त्वा aff.

r. 10th cl. (स्पृहयति)
To wish, to desire, to long for.

f. (-हा)
Wish, desire.
E.
स्पृह to wish, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Desiring, wishing.
E.
स्पृह to desire, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Desirable, to be wished.
E.
स्पृह to wish, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Wishing, desiring, cupidinous.
E.
स्पृह to wish, आलुच् aff., and युक augment.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be wished, desirable.
m. (-ह्यः)
A large kind of lime.
E.
स्पृह to wish, aff. क्यप्.
